The Process

How Quantora Engineering Works

From the drawing package to a priced BOQ and issued shop drawings — four steps, one project. Watch it on a real project.

  • Create the project — drawings, BOQ, tenders and approvals in one place, across four dashboards
  • AI Take-off & BOQ — AI counts every item and marks it on the drawing, system-wise and floor-wise
  • Manual Take-off — you mark the drawing, Quantora designs the complete BOQ for every system
  • AI Draftsman — shop drawings, schematics and a 3D model to your authority rules, export to Excel, PDF or DWG
